name: read_file
description: Read a line-numbered excerpt from a local file (regular files only; directories are not supported). Paths may be absolute or relative to the effective working directory shown in the system prompt. Use offset/limit to page: a large limit for a broad overview during discovery, a small limit for a precise line-range read once you know the region you need. Set use_line_numbers=false to get the raw content without line-number prefixes (e.g. to copy exact text into apply_patch).

file_path.description: Path to a regular file to read, either absolute or relative to the effective working directory (directories are not supported; some sensitive paths are blocked).

limit.description: Number of lines to read (default: 1000). Use a large limit for a broad overview, a small one (e.g. 20-40) for a precise slice. Very large results are capped; a truncation notice gives the offset to continue from.

use_line_numbers.description: Whether to prefix each line with its 1-based line number (default: true). Set to false to return the raw file content; offset/limit paging and the truncation notice still apply.
